notes.title: Demo Update V0.6.02 - Bug fixes and QOL Improvements
notes.notes:
V0.6.02 Update List

Global Leaderboards

 Now show your Steam Username instead of local Character (Use local leaderboard to identify which character it was)


Player Settings for Golfer

 Now properly saving and loading your custom settings
 Added a Reset to Default Button


Golf Modifiers for Match Play now an Option

 Added an Option at Starter to turn off Skill modifiers when playing a match
 Playing with Modifiers disabled will not Publish Score to Global Leaderboard
 Playing with Modifiers disabled will reset your characters current modifiers
 Playing with Modifiers disabled will cause Consumables to not apply their effects


Fixed Client/Host Disconnection issues

 Client now cleanly disconnects from Host when both quitting server and when host ends game mode
 Hose now cleanly handles Client leaving game room and also host ending game room
 Client now can disconnect and reconnect or join new room without requiring restart


Changed Fullscreen from checkbox to list of options with Borderless now an option

 Choose from Windowed, Borderless or Exclusive Fullscreen options


Fixed Bug for Steam Achievement of Starring all maps causing lockup

Improved Golfer Start Menu functionality

 Some bugginess has been resolved


Fixed Changing maps while menu open

 Now properly resetting character and closing open menus

notes.title: V0.6.01 - First Demo Patch
notes.notes:
V0.6.01 - Released
We have provided a patch to address some issues found by players so far.

Some players experienced game freezes. 
- This seemed to commonly occur when starting to lineup with the ball
- More frequently happened to MK players but also to Controller players
- We have found a cause and have implemented a fix.
Tutorial had a couple bugs preventing users from being able to complete it.
- Force field at hole would not go down (fixed)
- Skill menu would lock up when playing the hole (fixed)
Leader boards were only showing Top 9 Scores
- Now properly showing the Top 10

Thank you everyone playing the game! And thank you for being patient to those that have experienced issues with the game.

If you still experience freezing or other types of crashes, please reach out to use on Discord so we can get it fixed ASAP. The more info we can get about what is causing the issue, the sooner we can get it fixed!

Thank you everyone,
Arne
